presets.name: Brushed metal
presets.description: Long fine streaks in the metal (colour only, never pixel height) over a soft mottle, with shallow dents that catch the light.

presets.name: Circuit board
presets.description: Circuit traces routed straight and diagonally (any angle), pads on the dead ends and vias, on a board; optionally glowing.

presets.name: Cobblestones
presets.description: Rounded irregular stones (Voronoi cells) with the stone-wall relief and paint.

presets.name: Concrete
presets.description: Soft mottled concrete or plaster: smudges, rain streaks, pits and speckle; optional cast panels with seams and bolt holes.

presets.name: Cut-out
presets.description: An opening that writes a mask (Opening, and Opening frame for its frame ring), added at the top of the stack so the materials below can use it: limit the material in front to Opening Or Opening frame with Invert, and the one behind to Opening (each material’s Mask card). A recessed step at its edge and an optional raised frame around it.

presets.name: Grate & vents
presets.description: A grid of slots, holes or louvres in a plate, optionally framed and bolted: floor grates, wall vents, grilles.

presets.name: Hammered copper
presets.description: Interlocking radial arcs of hammer dents, toned in the dents, with an optional patina.

presets.name: Lava
presets.description: Lava, water, slime or nukage: light refracted through the wavy surface gathers into bright filaments around dark cells (or a stylised caustic net / blobs).

presets.name: Light panel
presets.description: Glowing tubes in dark recessed housings on a metal panel (fluorescent strips, tech lights).

presets.name: Marble
presets.description: Veined stone: flowing ridged veins, streaks, a vein network or cells over clouded colour; optionally cut into tiles.

presets.name: Metal plate
presets.description: Iron or steel plate: fine mottle, rust patches and scratches; optional tread pattern, seams and rivets.

presets.name: Peeling paint
presets.description: Paint over whatever is beneath — tiles, plates, concrete — flaking off in ragged chips to rust or bare substrate, with a raised paint edge, mottling, rust streaks and grime.

presets.name: Chrome pipes
presets.description: Pipe runs on a wall — rusty, painted, copper, steel, chrome, plastic or glass — with elbows, tees, crossings, collars and bolted flanges: round, glossy where they should be, shadow-casting, weathered.

presets.name: Copper pipes
presets.description: Pipe runs on a wall — rusty, painted, copper, steel, chrome, plastic or glass — with elbows, tees, crossings, collars and bolted flanges: round, glossy where they should be, shadow-casting, weathered.

presets.name: Glass tubes
presets.description: Pipe runs on a wall — rusty, painted, copper, steel, chrome, plastic or glass — with elbows, tees, crossings, collars and bolted flanges: round, glossy where they should be, shadow-casting, weathered.

presets.name: Painted pipes
presets.description: Pipe runs on a wall — rusty, painted, copper, steel, chrome, plastic or glass — with elbows, tees, crossings, collars and bolted flanges: round, glossy where they should be, shadow-casting, weathered.

presets.name: Rusty pipes
presets.description: Pipe runs on a wall — rusty, painted, copper, steel, chrome, plastic or glass — with elbows, tees, crossings, collars and bolted flanges: round, glossy where they should be, shadow-casting, weathered.

presets.name: Steel pipes
presets.description: Pipe runs on a wall — rusty, painted, copper, steel, chrome, plastic or glass — with elbows, tees, crossings, collars and bolted flanges: round, glossy where they should be, shadow-casting, weathered.

presets.name: Rock face
presets.description: Fractured, bedded stone: tilted blocks with stepped scarps and finer facets, shaded scarps, dirt or moss in the crevices.

presets.name: Water & rust stains
presets.description: Water stains darkening what is beneath, rust trails where they are strongest (same sources), optional paint blisters; sources scattered or on the ledges of the relief.

presets.name: Stone wall
presets.description: Dressed blocks to hand-placed rubble: domed faces, crisp chipped edges, per-stone height and colour, moss and grime.

presets.name: Stripes
presets.description: Warning stripes and alternating bands — diagonal, straight, chevrons, zig-zags or checks — in two colours with crisp edges, wear and grime.

presets.name: Tiles
presets.description: Square, hex, diamond, diagonal-bond, herringbone or basketweave tiles, bone or plus pavers, fan or ring setts: crisp bevels, per-tile colour and height, grout and grime.

presets.name: Water
presets.description: Lava, water, slime or nukage: light refracted through the wavy surface gathers into bright filaments around dark cells (or a stylised caustic net / blobs).

presets.name: Wood
presets.description: Boards or a single slab: grain, growth rings, figure and knots, with board gaps and staggered joints.
